magic_items.name: Black dragon scale shield
magic_items.description: The shield Gorrunk was using was actually the scale of a black dragon. While it acts simply as a regular shield, it is a trophy that can be carried with pride.

magic_items.name: Spell Scroll: Protection from Evil and Good
magic_items.description: This spell scroll contains a single protection from evil and good spell. A description of spell scrolls can be found in the basic rules or Dungeon Master's Guide.

magic_items.name: Spell Scroll: Comprehend Languages
magic_items.description: This spell scroll contains a single comprehend languages spell. A description of spell scrolls can be found in the basic rules or Dungeon Master's Guide.

magic_items.name: Enchanted Blue Dragon's Tooth
magic_items.description: A character that possesses this item for more than a day has vulnerability to lightning damage.

npcs.name: Yllivia

features.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
features.description: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

npcs.description: An elf member of the Order of the Gauntlet, a group dedicated to fighting the tyranny of the Black Fist knights.

npcs.name: Villonah
npcs.description: A gnome member of the Order of the Gauntlet, imprisoned by the Black Fist guards. She stole a map from the Black Fists that is rumored to lead to the lair of a white dragon in the mountains to the north, hiding it on the sole of her right foot under a patch of fake skin.

traps.name: Tripwire Alarm Trap
traps.trigger: Any creature passing through the area containing the tripwire sets off the trap. The tripwire is set across the entrance to this room, roughly two feet above the ground.

detection.detail: The trap can be found with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) check.

disarm.detail: Disabled by a character with a set of thieves' tools with a successful DC 10 Dexterity check.

traps.effect: If triggered, stones fall into the ceiling of the 10-foot by 40-foot section of Area 2A directly north of the tripwire. Any creature in the trapped area takes 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage from falling rocks. The trap also sets off alarm bells in other parts of the lair. If the trap is successfully disarmed, pulling the alarm rope in other areas of the lair has no effect.
traps.area: 10-foot by 40-foot section of Area 2A directly north of the tripwire
traps.description: A tripwire set across the entrance to a room, roughly two feet above the ground, that triggers falling stones and alarm bells when tripped.

traps.name: Xandria's Crypt Gas Trap
traps.trigger: The trap triggers soon after the sarcophagus lid is removed and its contents examined.
traps.effect: The door closes and seals, and a hissing sound makes you aware that some kind of gas is entering the crypt. It does not smell pleasant.
traps.description: A trap in Xandria's crypt that seals the door and releases a foul-smelling gas after the sarcophagus is disturbed.

traps.name: Poison Needle Trap (Throne)
traps.trigger: Opening the hinged panel in the bottom of the throne without disarming the trap

detection.detail: Noticed with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check

disarm.detail: Disabled with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check, provided the character attempting this check has a set of thieves' tools

traps.effect: A needle sticks the creature opening the panel
traps.description: A poison needle trap on a hinged panel in the bottom of a throne.

traps.name: Poison Gas Trap (Crypt)
traps.trigger: Removing the sarcophagus lid and examining the contents

detection.detail: No detection check specified; the gas is noticeable by smell

disarm.detail: Inserting the correct gems into the wall carvings within two rounds dissipates the gas

traps.effect: The crypt door seals and poisonous gas fills the room
traps.description: A trap that seals the crypt and releases poisonous gas when the sarcophagus is disturbed.

traps.name: Collapsing Obelisk Ceiling
traps.trigger: Destroying an obelisk (AC 8, 5 hp) or pushing it over with a successful DC 5 Strength check causes the ceiling of the cavern around the obelisk to collapse.

detection.detail: No detection check specified; the obelisks are quite old and fragile and visibly so.

traps.effect: The ceiling of the cavern around the obelisk collapses, dealing 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage to each creature in a square adjacent to the obelisks and knocking that creature prone. A creature making a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw takes only half damage and is not knocked prone.
traps.area: Each square adjacent to the obelisks
traps.description: The obelisks in the cavern are quite old and fragile. Destroying or toppling one causes the surrounding ceiling to collapse.
